extras.reason: Batching introduces repeated list(self.pending) conversion before slicing. With n notices, fixed batch_size=1, and successful atomic sends, the changed loop copies n+(n-1)+...+1 references, unlike the base single-pass drain. The stated 100,000-notice trigger and quadratic time/large temporary allocation impact follow directly from the supplied source.
